reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited clause supports it: p0001 expressly states nothing creates an exclusive arrangement and that the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering Inventory via other agents or selling to third parties — i.e., the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original text.
Rationale correctly distinguishes ordinary platform licence-use restrictions and confidentiality undertakings from restrictive covenants on Customer's business, so no over-flagging occurred.
Deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
